newsitem.title: USA: Clean Diesel says agent cuts emissions.
newsitem.headline: Clean Diesel says agent cuts emissions.

text.p: Clean Diesel Technologies Inc said a survey found that its Platinum Plus diesel fuel additive curtailed particle emissions when used with a standard heavy-duty diesel oxidation catalyst.

Test results indicated a 26 percent reduction in particulates when the diesel oxidizer was used in conjunction with Platinum Plus, compared with an 18 percent reduction with the diesel oxidizer acting alone, the company said.
Testing was conducted on a four-cycle heavy-duty diesel bus engine under the EPA's Federal Test Procedure.
Clean Diesel said it is actively seeking to expand its strategic alliances both with catalyst and engine manufacturers for the development of new products to cut emissions.
The company's Platinum Plus is a stable fuel additive that continuously adds minute amounts of platinum to the engine, which improves engine combustion, Clean Diesel said.
